units.source_text: 江湖画师把隔扇全部画完，便乘马车翻过这座山头走了。

en.t: After the itinerant painter finished painting all the sliding partitions, he rode away by carriage over this mountain.

units.source_text: 看来他准备对阿时不辞而别。

en.t: It seemed that he meant to leave without saying goodbye to Ashi.

units.source_text: 他冲着前来送他到马店的阿泷她们，带笑地说：

en.t: Smiling, he said to Otaki and the others, who had come to see him off at the horse inn:
